component.name: OskKeyboard
component.script:
sub init() m.txt = m.top.findNode("txt") m.keysGrp = m.top.findNode("keys") m.pop = m.top.findNode("pop") m.timer = m.top.findNode("holdTimer") m.timer.observeField("fire", "onHold") m.text = "" m.shift = false m.page = "abc" m.okDown = false m.popOpen = false m.fr = 1 m.fc = 0 m.acc = { a: ["á","à","â","ã","ä"], e: ["é","è","ê","ë"], i: ["í","ì","î","ï"], o: ["ó","ò","ô","õ","ö"], u: ["ú","ù","û","ü"], c: ["ç"], n: ["ñ"] } m.accUp = { a: ["Á","À","Â","Ã","Ä"], e: ["É","È","Ê","Ë"], i: ["Í","Ì","Î","Ï"], o: ["Ó","Ò","Ô","Õ","Ö"], u: ["Ú","Ù","Û","Ü"], c: ["Ç"], n: ["Ñ"] } buildKeys() refreshText() end sub
function LayoutRows() as Object if m.page = "sym" return ["1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 0", "@ # $ % & * ( ) ! ?", "- _ + = / : ; " + Chr(34) + " ' ,", "{abc}:1.5 . ~ ^ | \ [ ] {del}:1.5", "{abc}:1.5 {space}:5 . {ok}:2.5"] end if return ["1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 0", "q w e r t y u i o p", "a s d f g h j k l ç", "{shift}:1.5 z x c v b n m {del}:1.5", "{sym}:1.5 {space}:5 . {ok}:2.5"] end function
function UpperChar(k as String) as String if k = "ç" then return "Ç" return UCase(k) end function
function KeyDisplay(k as String) as String if k = "{shift}" then return "Aa" if k = "{del}" then return "APAGAR" if k = "{sym}" then return "?123" if k = "{abc}" then return "ABC" if k = "{space}" then return "ESPAÇO" if k = "{ok}" then return m.top.okLabel if m.shift and m.page = "abc" then return UpperChar(k) return k end function
sub buildKeys() m.keysGrp.removeChildrenIndex(m.keysGrp.getChildCount(), 0) m.keys = [] rows = LayoutRows() y = 0 for ri = 0 to rows.Count() - 1 toks = rows[ri].Split(" ") row = [] x = 0.0 for each tk in toks k = tk w = 1.0 if Left(tk, 1) = "{" p = tk.Split(":") k = p[0] w = Val(p[1]) end if bw = w * 84 - 8 r = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Rectangle") r.translation = [x, y] r.width = bw r.height = 76 l = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Label") l.translation = [x, y] l.width = bw l.height = 76 l.horizAlign = "center" l.vertAlign = "center" if Left(k, 1) = "{" l.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" else l.font = "font:MediumSystemFont" end if m.keysGrp.appendChild(r) m.keysGrp.appendChild(l) row.Push({ k: k, x: x, w: bw, rect: r, lbl: l }) x = x + w * 84 end for m.keys.Push(row) y = y + 84 end for if m.fr > m.keys.Count() - 1 then m.fr = m.keys.Count() - 1 if m.fc > m.keys[m.fr].Count() - 1 then m.fc = m.keys[m.fr].Count() - 1 refreshLabels() end sub
sub refreshLabels() if m.keys = invalid then return for ri = 0 to m.keys.Count() - 1 for ci = 0 to m.keys[ri].Count() - 1 kk = m.keys[ri][ci] kk.lbl.text = KeyDisplay(kk.k) kk.lbl.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" end for end for hlFocus() end sub
sub hlFocus() for ri = 0 to m.keys.Count() - 1 for ci = 0 to m.keys[ri].Count() - 1 kk = m.keys[ri][ci] c = "0x2B2B2BEE" if Left(kk.k, 1) = "{" then c = "0x474747EE" if kk.k = "{shift}" and m.shift then c = "0xB71C1CFF" if ri = m.fr and ci = m.fc then c = "0xE5231FFF" kk.rect.color = c end for end for end sub
sub onTextSet() if m.top.text <> m.text m.text = m.top.text refreshText() end if end sub
sub refreshText() if m.txt = invalid then return if m.text = "" m.txt.text = m.top.hint m.txt.color = "0xFFFFFF88" else t = m.text if m.top.secret then t = String(Len(m.text), "*") m.txt.text = t + "|" m.txt.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" end if end sub
sub typeChar(ch as String) m.text = m.text + ch m.top.text = m.text refreshText() end sub
sub backspace() if Len(m.text) > 0 m.text = Left(m.text, Len(m.text) - 1) m.top.text = m.text refreshText() end if end sub
function AccentsFor(k as String) as Object if m.page <> "abc" then return [] if not m.acc.DoesExist(k) then return [] if m.shift then return m.accUp[k] return m.acc[k] end function
sub pressKey(k as String) if k = "{shift}" m.shift = not m.shift refreshLabels() else if k = "{sym}" m.page = "sym" buildKeys() else if k = "{abc}" m.page = "abc" buildKeys() else if k = "{del}" backspace() else if k = "{space}" typeChar(" ") else if k = "{ok}" m.top.submit = true else ch = k if m.shift and m.page = "abc" then ch = UpperChar(k) typeChar(ch) if m.shift m.shift = false refreshLabels() end if end if end sub
sub onHold() if not m.okDown then return m.okDown = false k = m.keys[m.fr][m.fc].k opts = AccentsFor(k) if opts.Count() > 0 then openPopup(opts) end sub
sub openPopup(opts as Object) m.pop.removeChildrenIndex(m.pop.getChildCount(), 0) kk = m.keys[m.fr][m.fc] w = opts.Count() * 84 + 12 px = kk.x if px + w > 836 then px = 836 - w m.pop.translation = [px, 104 + m.fr * 84 - 100] bg = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Rectangle") bg.width = w bg.height = 92 bg.color = "0x000000F5" m.pop.appendChild(bg) m.popRects = [] for i = 0 to opts.Count() - 1 r = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Rectangle") r.translation = [6 + i * 84, 8] r.width = 76 r.height = 76 l = CreateObject("roSGNode", "Label") l.translation = [6 + i * 84, 8] l.width = 76 l.height = 76 l.horizAlign = "center" l.vertAlign = "center" l.font = "font:MediumSystemFont" l.text = opts[i] m.pop.appendChild(r) m.pop.appendChild(l) m.popRects.Push(r) end for m.popOpts = opts m.ai = 0 m.popOpen = true m.pop.visible = true hlPop() end sub
sub hlPop() for i = 0 to m.popRects.Count() - 1 if i = m.ai m.popRects[i].color = "0xE5231FFF" else m.popRects[i].color = "0x2B2B2BFF" end if end for end sub
sub closePopup() m.pop.visible = false m.popOpen = false end sub
sub moveRow(dr as Integer) cur = m.keys[m.fr][m.fc] cx = cur.x + cur.w / 2 nr = m.fr + dr best = 0 bd = 99999 for i = 0 to m.keys[nr].Count() - 1 kk = m.keys[nr][i] d = Abs(kk.x + kk.w / 2 - cx) if d < bd bd = d best = i end if end for m.fr = nr m.fc = best hlFocus() end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if m.popOpen if key = "OK" if press ch = m.popOpts[m.ai] closePopup() typeChar(ch) if m.shift m.shift = false refreshLabels() end if end if return true end if if press if key = "left" and m.ai > 0 m.ai = m.ai - 1 hlPop() else if key = "right" and m.ai < m.popOpts.Count() - 1 m.ai = m.ai + 1 hlPop() else if key = "back" or key = "up" or key = "down" closePopup() end if end if return true end if
if key = "OK" k = m.keys[m.fr][m.fc].k if press if m.okDown then return true if AccentsFor(k).Count() > 0 m.okDown = true m.timer.control = "stop" m.timer.control = "start" else pressKey(k) end if else if m.okDown m.okDown = false m.timer.control = "stop" pressKey(k) end if end if return true end if
if not press then return false if key = "left" if m.fc > 0 m.fc = m.fc - 1 hlFocus() return true end if return false else if key = "right" if m.fc < m.keys[m.fr].Count() - 1 m.fc = m.fc + 1 hlFocus() return true end if return false else if key = "up" if m.fr > 0 moveRow(-1) return true end if return false else if key = "down" if m.fr < m.keys.Count() - 1 moveRow(1) return true end if return false else if key = "rewind" backspace() return true else if key = "fastforward" typeChar(" ") return true end if return false end function
